name: vivreal-content
description: Vivreal's social and content production fleet, migrated out of vivreal-hq's local .claude directory. content-planner plans the cross-platform calendar (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, 16 posts a week); footage-recorder captures shared portal footage into the library; short-form-editor, linkedin-editor, carousel-editor, and social-video-director (the batch coordinator over the first two) turn that footage into platform-tailored DRAFT posts; guide-writer turns a footage session into a voice-checked blog draft and tutorial-maker into a scripted or live how-to (Meta App Review takes included); help-page-producer runs the verify-first help-centre backlog; mascot-artist re-poses the Vivreal duck mascot from its 3D model in Blender (headless, flat colours, inked outlines) and iterates on owner feedback. Every editor is draft only, a human publishes. Plus the matching /carousel, /guide, /help-page, /instagram, /linkedin, /record, /social, /tiktok, and /tutorial commands. Distinct from vivreal-product's social-critic (which critiques a finished draft) and template-critic (which judges a built template). Repo-specific run notes live in the working repo's docs/agent-notes/, read by the agent when present.
